overview.en:
Use Sei’s official MCP to inspect blocks, balances, tokens, NFTs and contracts, with a separate optional wallet connection for authorized transactions.

Compare wallet activity and trace token movements across the selected network. Start with a chain, address, and time range; keep transaction identifiers and distinguish native assets from tokens.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Sei 官方 MCP 查询区块、余额、代币、NFT 与合约，并通过独立可选的钱包连接执行已授权的交易。

从指定网络的钱包活动入手，追踪代币流转。提供链、地址和时间范围后，可按交易整理结果，并区分原生资产与代币。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this wallet's recent transactions on the selected network, with transaction IDs.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个钱包在指定网络的近期交易，并列出交易哈希。

starterPrompts.en: Trace this transaction and explain the addresses and token transfers involved.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 追踪这笔交易，解释涉及的地址与代币转账。

starterPrompts.en: Compare the activity of these two addresses over the same time range.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两个地址在相同时间范围内的链上活动。
